name: calc_card_surjective_fin_three
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n → Fin 3)).filter (fun f => Function.Surjective f)).card : ℤ) = 3 ^ n - 3 * 2 ^ n + 3
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n), (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n → Fin 3)).filter (fun f => Function.Surjective f)).card : ℤ) = 3 ^ n - 3 * 2 ^ n + 3
informal: Number of surjections from an n-set (n ≥ 1) onto a 3-set is 3ⁿ − 3·2ⁿ + 3 — inclusion–exclusion over the missed values; count functions avoiding a given value (2ⁿ) and avoiding two values (1).
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ↑{f | Function.Surjective f}.card = 3 ^ n - 3 * 2 ^ n + 3
